author: nanouai
title: Kids' activities and routines
blurb: Class reminders with leave-by times, school news and daily checklists.
sample: Swimming at 5:30: leave by 5:05, and the goggles are still in the car.
firstMessage: Help me keep track of the kids' activities: find their classes and school events in my calendar and mail, list them for the week, and remind me when it's time to leave.
